main_text.p: peritissimus Dn. Antonius Thysius, quem ex tota antiqui- tate nihil latet, ex instructissima sua Bibliotheca historiam Pseudogorionidæ Hebraicam mihi suppeditavit : ubi cum ea quæ de templo conscripserat animo lustrassem, multaque à Iudæorum præstantissimis scriptis dissona reperissem; coepi di- ligentius in ipsius fidem inquirere. Tandem, quod sæpius ab aliis annotatum legeram , Josephum hunc scriptorem suppo- sititium esse deprehendi: quippe qui multo sit recentior, quam præ se ferat ; multaque mendacia accumulet. Vtriusque unum atque alterum argumentum ex infinitis ferme protu- lisse sufficiet ; quo constet omnibus, Misnajoth sequentium fidem minime in dubium ideo vocandam, quod ipsis hic Pseu- dogorionides refragetur. Primò itaque lib. 6. cap. 1. sive to- tius operis cap. 43. fol. edit. Cracov. 53. ubi Iulij Victoriam, quam de Gallis reportavit, paucis enarrat, ita scribit ויכנע (sic scribendum, non פרחקום ut Cracov.edit. hoc loco habet, alia loca docent ) & subjugavit populum Francorum. At quis adeo hospes in historia, ut à vero Josepho ad Francorum in Galliam adventum secula aliquot effluxisse ignorare queat? Idem ille Pseudogorionides putidam inscitiam mendacio manifestissimo prodit, quum fol. 25, id est, l. 3. cap. 1. sive totius operis cap. 14. de Ptolomæo Phi- ladelpho Aegypti rege subjicit ויםח הוא ויסלך תחחיו איםפיראום והוא קיסר על רומי ועל מצריים ועל ירושלם ועל בבל ועל מרי ופרס & eo mortuo regnavit ipsius loco IMPERIVM (vel IMPERIVS, ut loquitur) is est Cæsar qui Romæ,in Aegypto,

page.notes: Hebrew lines transcribed as seen; the first line of the Hebrew block (ויםח הוא ויסלך תחחיו איםפיראום) and the line והוא קיסר על רומי ועל מצריים ועל ירושלם ועל בבל ועל מרי are doubtful in individual letters and may need checking against the scan. The Hebrew word ויכנע and the transliterated name פרחקום are as printed in the text. Long s is plain s throughout. Italic and roman boundaries in the Latin are read from the scan and may be slightly off at the edges of italic runs. The far right edge shows fragments of the neighbouring page and was not transcribed. No page number is printed.
